title: PermDock CLI result v1
description: What every `permdock` command prints on stdout under `--json`, `--format json` or agent mode: one envelope per run, success or not. `data` is the command's report; `error` is RFC 9457 Problem Details. Fields are only added within v1.

status.description: `action_required` exits 3: the run needs input, consent or a login that only a person can give.

data.description: The command's report. Its shape is the command's own; a report with its own `$schema` keeps it.

next.description: Commands that move the run forward, in order.

command.description: A complete command line, starting with `permdock`.

when.description: The condition under which to run it, such as `after the person agrees`.

type.description: The code's heading on the errors page, `https://permdock.com/docs/cli/errors#<code>`.

code.description: Stable, snake_case; new codes are only added within v1.

command.description: The command path, such as `rls generate`.
